title: XXXIII. Of Excommunicate Perſons, how they are to be avoided.

segments.text: THat perſon which by open Denunciation of the Church, is rightly cut off from the Unity of the Church, and excommunicated, ought to be taken of the whole multitude of the faithful, as an Heathen and Publicane, until he be openly reconciled by Penance, and received into the Church by a Judge that hath Authority thereunto,
